title: Monarch's Gaze
description: Whenever you attack an enemy, it loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
smart_description: Whenever you attack an enemy, it loses [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this turn.
notes: Triggers on any powered attack (not just powers, but also attacks like playing Attack cards). Applies a temporary strength debuff to the target that lasts only until end of the target's turn.
